meta.title: Irreverent Gluttony - 3
meta.description: Grand words and elegant phrasing cannot hide the emptiness of your heart.

units.rawText: ...It really is infuriating.
units.displayText: ...It really is infuriating.

spans.text: ...It really is infuriating.

units.rawText: Hm? You aren't talking about me, are you?
units.displayText: Hm? You aren't talking about me, are you?

spans.text: Hm? You aren't talking about me, are you?

units.rawText: No, I wanted to say that the Sacred...
units.displayText: No, I wanted to say that the Sacred...

spans.text: No, I wanted to say that the Sacred...

units.rawText: The Sacred?
units.displayText: The Sacred?

spans.text: The Sacred?

units.rawText: ...These remaining monsters really are infuriating.
units.displayText: ...These remaining monsters really are infuriating.

spans.text: ...These remaining monsters really are infuriating.

units.rawText: Misspeaking, Eucharist can only change the topic.
units.displayText: Misspeaking, Eucharist can only change the topic.

spans.text: Misspeaking, Eucharist can only change the topic.

units.rawText: She throws the weapon in her hand, impaling the monster in front of her in one operand-enhanced strike.
units.displayText: She throws the weapon in her hand, impaling the monster in front of her in one operand-enhanced strike.

spans.text: She throws the weapon in her hand, impaling the monster in front of her in one operand-enhanced strike.

units.rawText: As expected of a Greater Sanctifier, displaying such efficacy with only a few forays into the field.
units.displayText: As expected of a Greater Sanctifier, displaying such efficacy with only a few forays into the field.

spans.text: As expected of a Greater Sanctifier, displaying such efficacy with only a few forays into the field.

units.rawText: Tell me, Eucharist, have you felt the great weight of the Sanctifiers' duty pulling upon the strings of your neural cloud in combat?
units.displayText: Tell me, Eucharist, have you felt the great weight of the Sanctifiers' duty pulling upon the strings of your neural cloud in combat?

spans.text: Tell me, Eucharist, have you felt the great weight of the Sanctifiers' duty pulling upon the strings of your neural cloud in combat?

units.rawText: Unfortunately, what you speak of does not exist.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, what you speak of does not exist.

spans.text: Unfortunately, what you speak of does not exist.

units.rawText: To me, I am simply doing as I am ordered.
units.displayText: To me, I am simply doing as I am ordered.

spans.text: To me, I am simply doing as I am ordered.

units.rawText: Eucharist recalls her weapon, flicking away the foul liquids upon her fork.
units.displayText: Eucharist recalls her weapon, flicking away the foul liquids upon her fork.

spans.text: Eucharist recalls her weapon, flicking away the foul liquids upon her fork.

units.rawText: ...If I were to be accurate, what I feel can only be described as "disgust".
units.displayText: ...If I were to be accurate, what I feel can only be described as "disgust".

spans.text: ...If I were to be accurate, what I feel can only be described as "disgust".

units.rawText: She looks at the remnants of a Lesser Sanctifier by her feet that she had been trying to ignore.
units.displayText: She looks at the remnants of a Lesser Sanctifier by her feet that she had been trying to ignore.

spans.text: She looks at the remnants of a Lesser Sanctifier by her feet that she had been trying to ignore.

units.rawText: Defeat here means death, right?
units.displayText: Defeat here means death, right?

spans.text: Defeat here means death, right?

units.rawText: That is not death, but hallowed sacrifice in the course of carrying out the Sanctifiers' duty.
units.displayText: That is not death, but hallowed sacrifice in the course of carrying out the Sanctifiers' duty.

spans.text: That is not death, but hallowed sacrifice in the course of carrying out the Sanctifiers' duty.

units.rawText: What difference is there between death and sacrifice... it's just grasping at straws for a euphemism.
units.displayText: What difference is there between death and sacrifice... it's just grasping at straws for a euphemism.

spans.text: What difference is there between death and sacrifice... it's just grasping at straws for a euphemism.

units.rawText: It appears you do not understand the nobility that lies in protecting others.
units.displayText: It appears you do not understand the nobility that lies in protecting others.

spans.text: It appears you do not understand the nobility that lies in protecting others.

units.rawText: Put in some more effort, Eucharist. If things continue as they are, your older sister's going to leave you behind.
units.displayText: Put in some more effort, Eucharist. If things continue as they are, your older sister's going to leave you behind.

spans.text: Put in some more effort, Eucharist. If things continue as they are, your older sister's going to leave you behind.

units.rawText: She looks in the direction Raven indicates.
units.displayText: She looks in the direction Raven indicates.

spans.text: She looks in the direction Raven indicates.

units.rawText: As Raven had exclaimed, Angelus is in the middle of the havoc, engaging the main force of the Entropic foe.
units.displayText: As Raven had exclaimed, Angelus is in the middle of the havoc, engaging the main force of the Entropic foe.

spans.text: As Raven had exclaimed, Angelus is in the middle of the havoc, engaging the main force of the Entropic foe.

units.rawText: Viscous liquid, disturbed by an exploding arrow, makes contact with her face. Angelus only nonchalantly wipes at it with the back of her hand, rushing towards the enemy with bow in hand.
units.displayText: Viscous liquid, disturbed by an exploding arrow, makes contact with her face. Angelus only nonchalantly wipes at it with the back of her hand, rushing towards the enemy with bow in hand.

spans.text: Viscous liquid, disturbed by an exploding arrow, makes contact with her face. Angelus only nonchalantly wipes at it with the back of her hand, rushing towards the enemy with bow in hand.

units.rawText: Uwah... why fight so hard, Big Sis... Isn't it dangerous to do that?
units.displayText: Uwah... why fight so hard, Big Sis... Isn't it dangerous to do that?

spans.text: Uwah... why fight so hard, Big Sis... Isn't it dangerous to do that?

units.rawText: It's all just work, why not just put in the minimum and get by...
units.displayText: It's all just work, why not just put in the minimum and get by...

spans.text: It's all just work, why not just put in the minimum and get by...

units.rawText: No, no, no, how could you call it "just work"?
units.displayText: No, no, no, how could you call it "just work"?

spans.text: No, no, no, how could you call it "just work"?

units.rawText: This is our duty, our divine burden bestowed upon us since our very births.
units.displayText: This is our duty, our divine burden bestowed upon us since our very births.

spans.text: This is our duty, our divine burden bestowed upon us since our very births.

units.rawText: Raven closes her eyes, placing a balled fist to her chest.
units.displayText: Raven closes her eyes, placing a balled fist to her chest.

spans.text: Raven closes her eyes, placing a balled fist to her chest.

units.rawText: ...You aren't going to recite that oath again, are you?
units.displayText: ...You aren't going to recite that oath again, are you?

spans.text: ...You aren't going to recite that oath again, are you?

units.rawText: I am. This is something of utmost importance to us Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: I am. This is something of utmost importance to us Sanctifiers.

spans.text: I am. This is something of utmost importance to us Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: She pauses intentionally, giving her companion next to her an expectant look.
units.displayText: She pauses intentionally, giving her companion next to her an expectant look.

spans.text: She pauses intentionally, giving her companion next to her an expectant look.

units.rawText: ...(Sigh).
units.displayText: ...(Sigh).

spans.text: ...(Sigh).

units.rawText: As Raven's burning gaze drills into her, Eucharist can only follow along.
units.displayText: As Raven's burning gaze drills into her, Eucharist can only follow along.

spans.text: As Raven's burning gaze drills into her, Eucharist can only follow along.

units.rawText: For we heed the commandments of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the commandments of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the commandments of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: Wrong! Revelations, not commandments!
units.displayText: Wrong! Revelations, not commandments!

spans.text: Wrong! Revelations, not commandments!

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: Got that, Eucharist?
units.displayText: Got that, Eucharist?

spans.text: Got that, Eucharist?

units.rawText: What's the difference between the two, anyway... Whatever, I'll remember with a few more goes.
units.displayText: What's the difference between the two, anyway... Whatever, I'll remember with a few more goes.

spans.text: What's the difference between the two, anyway... Whatever, I'll remember with a few more goes.

units.rawText: Good. So long as you remember.
units.displayText: Good. So long as you remember.

spans.text: Good. So long as you remember.

units.rawText: In any case, I will leave the remaining Entropics in the back to you. I shall reinforce Angelus at the front.
units.displayText: In any case, I will leave the remaining Entropics in the back to you. I shall reinforce Angelus at the front.

spans.text: In any case, I will leave the remaining Entropics in the back to you. I shall reinforce Angelus at the front.

units.rawText: <size=40>Do not forget your duty as a Sanctifier!</size>
units.displayText: Do not forget your duty as a Sanctifier!

spans.text: Do not forget your duty as a Sanctifier!

units.rawText: Without waiting for a response, Raven flies off towards the frontline not far away.
units.displayText: Without waiting for a response, Raven flies off towards the frontline not far away.

spans.text: Without waiting for a response, Raven flies off towards the frontline not far away.

units.rawText: ...What a silly musclehead.
units.displayText: ...What a silly musclehead.

spans.text: ...What a silly musclehead.

units.rawText: Is there really a need for stuff like that?
units.displayText: Is there really a need for stuff like that?

spans.text: Is there really a need for stuff like that?

units.rawText: She didn't necessarily think that what she said was wrong. She simply had an aversion towards those ideas for reasons she did not know.
units.displayText: She didn't necessarily think that what she said was wrong. She simply had an aversion towards those ideas for reasons she did not know.

spans.text: She didn't necessarily think that what she said was wrong. She simply had an aversion towards those ideas for reasons she did not know.

units.rawText: Whatever, I'll ask her after the battle's over.
units.displayText: Whatever, I'll ask her after the battle's over.

spans.text: Whatever, I'll ask her after the battle's over.

units.rawText: She sighs helplessly, continuing with the cleanup at hand.
units.displayText: She sighs helplessly, continuing with the cleanup at hand.

spans.text: She sighs helplessly, continuing with the cleanup at hand.

units.rawText: She never thought that she would never have the opportunity to clear up her doubts again.
units.displayText: She never thought that she would never have the opportunity to clear up her doubts again.

spans.text: She never thought that she would never have the opportunity to clear up her doubts again.

units.rawText: Raven, as a Greater Sanctifier, you have fulfilled a Sanctifiers' duty well.
units.displayText: Raven, as a Greater Sanctifier, you have fulfilled a Sanctifiers' duty well.

spans.text: Raven, as a Greater Sanctifier, you have fulfilled a Sanctifiers' duty well.

units.rawText: Your sacrifice will not go wasted. In the near future, you shall be reborn from the Sacred Canon in a new form.
units.displayText: Your sacrifice will not go wasted. In the near future, you shall be reborn from the Sacred Canon in a new form.

spans.text: Your sacrifice will not go wasted. In the near future, you shall be reborn from the Sacred Canon in a new form.

units.rawText: His declarations complete, he lightly caresses Raven's forehead, closing the eyes of she who passed upon the battlefield.
units.displayText: His declarations complete, he lightly caresses Raven's forehead, closing the eyes of she who passed upon the battlefield.

spans.text: His declarations complete, he lightly caresses Raven's forehead, closing the eyes of she who passed upon the battlefield.

units.rawText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: The group disperses after the ceremony, leaving only Eucharist within the Pantheon.
units.displayText: The group disperses after the ceremony, leaving only Eucharist within the Pantheon.

spans.text: The group disperses after the ceremony, leaving only Eucharist within the Pantheon.

units.rawText: Raven's body is gradually consumed by the Sacred Canon's white light. As Eosphorus said, she will be reincarnated in the near future...
units.displayText: Raven's body is gradually consumed by the Sacred Canon's white light. As Eosphorus said, she will be reincarnated in the near future...

spans.text: Raven's body is gradually consumed by the Sacred Canon's white light. As Eosphorus said, she will be reincarnated in the near future...

units.rawText: She will lose her memories and fall in the field once more, repeating an inescapable cycle...
units.displayText: She will lose her memories and fall in the field once more, repeating an inescapable cycle...

spans.text: She will lose her memories and fall in the field once more, repeating an inescapable cycle...

units.rawText: What Sanctifiers' duty... What does it mean if you just go on and die?
units.displayText: What Sanctifiers' duty... What does it mean if you just go on and die?

spans.text: What Sanctifiers' duty... What does it mean if you just go on and die?

units.rawText: ...How stupid all of this is.
units.displayText: ...How stupid all of this is.

spans.text: ...How stupid all of this is.

units.rawText: Tell me, Canon. Did Alcyone and Electra go through the same process here back then?
units.displayText: Tell me, Canon. Did Alcyone and Electra go through the same process here back then?

spans.text: Tell me, Canon. Did Alcyone and Electra go through the same process here back then?

units.rawText: Never mind, if you don't feel like talking about it.
units.displayText: Never mind, if you don't feel like talking about it.

spans.text: Never mind, if you don't feel like talking about it.

units.rawText: Done with the topic, Eucharist turns around to leave, only to suddenly find another her standing ahead.
units.displayText: Done with the topic, Eucharist turns around to leave, only to suddenly find another her standing ahead.

spans.text: Done with the topic, Eucharist turns around to leave, only to suddenly find another her standing ahead.

units.rawText: Why show me Alcyone again, Canon?
units.displayText: Why show me Alcyone again, Canon?

spans.text: Why show me Alcyone again, Canon?

units.rawText: ...That is not Alcyone, Miss Eucharist.
units.displayText: ...That is not Alcyone, Miss Eucharist.

spans.text: ...That is not Alcyone, Miss Eucharist.

units.rawText: The heretofore silent Canon speaks.
units.displayText: The heretofore silent Canon speaks.

spans.text: The heretofore silent Canon speaks.

units.rawText: That is your own face.
units.displayText: That is your own face.

spans.text: That is your own face.

units.rawText: Eh? Mine?
units.displayText: Eh? Mine?

spans.text: Eh? Mine?

units.rawText: She inspects the visage of the person before her once again.
units.displayText: She inspects the visage of the person before her once again.

spans.text: She inspects the visage of the person before her once again.

units.rawText: ...Why... Why am I laughing?
units.displayText: ...Why... Why am I laughing?

spans.text: ...Why... Why am I laughing?
